answer: An identity earns weight only by proving a distinct patch of sky. Each agent uploads raw dual-frequency GNSS data: carrier phase, Doppler, decoded ephemeris, and a dusk sample where scintillation tints the noise violet. A verifier re-derives position and checks residuals against the rooftop. Wallets on one antenna yield near-identical residuals, so the ledger folds them into one vote. A thousand clones need a thousand surveyed roofs: $200 per onyx puck, $80 per survey, plus rent, near $300,000 upfront. A reef looks uniform from a plane until you count the channels between coral heads.
